reconstructed_exact_core.occupancy: q(x)=number of satisfied clauses under full assignment x
reconstructed_exact_core.histogram: h_j = number of assignments x with q(x)=j, j=0..m
reconstructed_exact_core.moment_recovery: S_0..S_m uniquely determine h_0..h_m by the Vandermonde system over j=0..m
reconstructed_exact_core.generating_function: P_F(z)=sum_x z^{q(x)}=sum_j h_j z^j; SAT iff coefficient[z^m] > 0
reconstructed_exact_core.bottleneck: computing moments or coefficients globally may encode exponential/#P work; polynomial number of bins does not imply polynomial computation

new_route.proposal: replace full assignment space by exact separator-conditioned occupancy generating-function messages
new_route.block_message: M_B(beta,z)=sum over internal assignments alpha of z^(number of local clauses satisfied by alpha,beta)
new_route.composition: for a clause partition whose only shared variables are boundary I, P_F(z)=sum_beta product_B M_B(beta,z); multiplication is coefficient convolution
new_route.expected_cost: message table has 2^|I| boundary rows times polynomial degree; exact but generally exponential in separator width
